title: docs(audit): drop organization_id from the record-view row columns
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9TAmgWWmAcmEVrHtnyoKy19)_
Fixes #31760
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:记录查看审计文档页的列表格删掉了不存在的 `organization_id` 列,只留 `tenant_id`,并加一句说明原因。
- 为什么改:`sys_audit_log` 声明了 `systemFields: { tenant: false }`,查看审计的写入方也只写 `tenant_id`;文档照着它找列会扑空。
- 风险与回滚:纯文档,不动 spec 与运行时;回滚就是 revert 这一笔提交。
- 先看:`content/docs/permissions/record-view-auditing.mdx` 的「What a view row records」表格及其下方新加的一段。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep -n "organization_id" content/docs/permissions/record-view-auditing.mdx`,预期只剩新加说明句里的那一处。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`content/docs/permissions/record-view-auditing.mdx`, the "What a view row records" table:

- The row `tenant_id` / `organization_id` becomes `tenant_id` alone.
- One new paragraph under the table: a view row has no `organization_id` column because `sys_audit_log` declares `systemFields: { tenant: false }`, so no organization column is injected, and `tenant_id` records the organization the viewed record belongs to.

No spec or runtime change. The spec and the runtime already agree with each other; the doc page is the side that drifted.

Step-0 readings, on `origin/main` at `c2bb879f`:

| Where | Reading |
| --- | --- |
| Doc table | `record-view-auditing.mdx:169` listed `tenant_id` / `organization_id` |
| Object | `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/objects/sys-audit-log.object.ts:91` declares `systemFields: { tenant: false }` (the card cites line 31; the declaration sits at 91 on this tree) |
| Writer | `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/read-audit.ts:600` `buildRow` writes `action`, `created_at`, `user_id`, `object_name`, `record_id`, `old_value`, `new_value`, `tenant_id`, plus `actor` when the column exists. No `organization_id`. |

A repo-wide sweep of `content/docs/` found no other page that names `organization_id` as a column of `sys_audit_log`, so this page is the only edit.

Forced test changes: none.

## Tests

Docs only: no package source changed, so there is no package test, typecheck, build closure or ablation leg owed.

## Acceptance notes

- Changeset: none. The diff touches only `content/docs/**`, which no package's `files[]` ships, so it publishes nothing and carries `skip-changeset`.
- `pnpm lint`: no package touched, so no per-package lint run is owed.
